description: RALEIGH – Today, on the first day of in-person early voting, Roy Cooper cast his ballot and discussed his plans to Make Stuff Cost Less for working North Carolinians. “I’m proud to have voted early and I encourage my fellow North Carolinians to make a plan to do the same,” said Roy Cooper. “So much […]
